data.title: The Truth on Generosity
data.description: Get to know more about Igor Barroso, a professional trader. In this series, he talks about how he was able to rise in his professional career, the day when he gave his life to Christ, how he is able to have a generous heart, and some of the strategies he used to begin in working as a professional trader.
data.creator: Igor Barroso
